scope: Rendered final EN/FR policy and consent-preference captures at Chromium 1280 CSS px and WebKit 320 CSS px. Content/links/contact visible; native page and footer remain. Automated privacy checks additionally assert no horizontal overflow and WCAG A/AA axe violations.
limitations: Full-page screenshots place the existing sticky header at its capture scroll position; they are not equivalent to a viewport-by-viewport physical-device inspection.
Long mobile full-page images are reduced by the viewer. Automated width/keyboard/axe checks supplement this visual review.
Physical iPhone Safari, real account ingestion and mail delivery are not tested.
